gap_families.title: Responses request controls
gap_families.input: instructions, service tier, strict output schema, stream options, client metadata and cache key
gap_families.state: requested controls remain distinct through canonical projection
gap_families.error: invalid or model-incompatible controls fail before credential and network access
gap_families.edge_case: absent and explicitly empty instructions remain distinguishable
gap_families.expected_proof: serde compatibility plus request golden fixtures

gap_families.title: Responses metadata
gap_families.output: response ID, effective model and tier, request ID, turn state, ETag, safety, verification, moderation and reasoning state
gap_families.state: metadata is merged in causal order without becoming transcript text
gap_families.error: malformed metadata is diagnosed without inventing a terminal
gap_families.edge_case: unknown metadata remains bounded and redacted
gap_families.expected_proof: vertical core-to-app-server fixture and transport fixtures

gap_families.title: HTTP configuration, headers and compression
gap_families.input: base URL, path, query, headers, retry policy, timeouts and compression policy
gap_families.output: one fully composed request with non-sensitive diagnostics
gap_families.state: transport configuration is immutable for an in-flight request
gap_families.error: invalid URL, header, compression or policy fails before opening a socket
gap_families.edge_case: zstd body decompresses byte-identically to the source JSON

gap_families.title: Responses SSE items and deltas
gap_families.output: item added/done, text, reasoning and tool deltas
gap_families.state: deltas publish immediately and terminal payloads remain authoritative
gap_families.error: an isolated malformed frame is diagnostic, not a stream restart
gap_families.edge_case: additive event types are observable and bounded

gap_families.title: Terminals, errors, quotas and usage
gap_families.input: HTTP status, terminal events, usage and all limit pools
gap_families.output: one success terminal or one typed failure with i64 counters and diagnostic IDs
gap_families.state: usage and response identity precede the terminal
gap_families.error: incomplete, failed and premature close never synthesize success
gap_families.edge_case: multiple limit pools and counters above u32::MAX remain distinct and exact

gap_families.title: Responses WebSocket handshake and lifecycle
gap_families.input: subscription URL, non-sensitive headers and response.create messages
gap_families.output: the same canonical events as SSE
gap_families.state: one response in flight, bounded prewarm/reuse/renew/close lifecycle
gap_families.error: auth, incompatibility and absent capability remain distinct
gap_families.edge_case: premature close invalidates the connection without leaking a task
gap_families.expected_proof: opt-in probe plus deterministic WebSocket fixtures

gap_families.title: Incremental continuation and session fallback
gap_families.output: one normalized event sequence regardless of transport
gap_families.state: previous response, turn state and session-scoped fallback are explicit
gap_families.error: previous_response_not_found permits one full retry only
gap_families.edge_case: fallback before acknowledgement cannot double execution or publication
gap_families.expected_proof: state machine and SSE/WebSocket equivalence fixtures

gap_families.title: Responses tool algebra
gap_families.input: function, custom, namespace, tool search and web search definitions
gap_families.output: complete call/output round trips without schema fabrication
gap_families.state: call identity and namespace survive added/done
gap_families.error: local incompatibility is typed before network access
gap_families.edge_case: strict is preserved when present and never forced when absent

gap_families.title: Complete response item vocabulary
gap_families.input: known and additive response item payloads
gap_families.output: complete provider-neutral item with identity and added/done phase
gap_families.state: items remain ordered independently from their deltas
gap_families.error: unrepresentable content is a bounded Other or a typed contract error
gap_families.edge_case: sensitive fields and signed URLs are redacted before projection or persistence
gap_families.expected_proof: unknown-item fixture plus full item matrix

gap_families.title: Scoped remote model catalog
gap_families.input: provider, endpoint and non-secret identity scope plus optional ETag
gap_families.state: fresh, stale and bypass-cache snapshots are distinguishable
gap_families.error: empty, oversized and transient failures preserve a scoped last-good snapshot
gap_families.edge_case: headless and interactive resolve through the same path

gap_families.title: Configurable providers and authentication
gap_families.input: ChatGPT OAuth or configured OpenAI-compatible provider credentials
gap_families.output: provider-neutral response and safe request diagnostics
gap_families.state: auth scope and at most one 401 recovery belong to a sampling
gap_families.error: transient refresh and permanent reconnect are distinct
gap_families.edge_case: credentials never cross provider origin or appear in errors
gap_families.expected_proof: provider fixtures and auth recovery fixtures

gap_families.title: Amazon Bedrock provider
gap_families.input: AWS identity, region and Bedrock model request
gap_families.output: canonical deltas, usage and stop reasons
gap_families.state: capabilities are probed and captured per provider
gap_families.error: service and stream exceptions retain typed retry classes
gap_families.edge_case: AWS credentials and signed material never enter fixtures or logs

gap_families.title: Remote compact and memories
gap_families.state: operation capability and timeout are explicit
gap_families.error: unsupported, timeout and malformed response have operation-specific errors
gap_families.edge_case: remote output never rewrites history until accepted by the caller

gap_families.title: Image generation and editing
gap_families.state: operation capability and timeout are explicit
gap_families.error: invalid image, policy and transport errors remain distinguishable
gap_families.edge_case: binary payload and signed URL content never enter logs or fixtures

gap_families.title: Search and file lifecycle
gap_families.input: typed search query or bounded file create/upload/finalize request
gap_families.output: search items or typed uploaded file descriptor
gap_families.state: file creation, upload and finalization states are explicit
gap_families.error: files over 512 MiB fail locally and upload-host failures stay typed
gap_families.edge_case: provider credentials are not forwarded to the signed upload host

gap_families.title: Realtime call and WebSocket
gap_families.input: typed SDP call or realtime session events
gap_families.output: typed realtime events and close result
gap_families.state: session mode, sideband join and writer lifecycle are bounded
gap_families.error: handshake, protocol and close failures remain distinct
gap_families.edge_case: cancellation reaches a terminal task state within the shutdown bound
